title: Multilingual Language Models are not Multicultural: A Case Study in Emotion

bias_targets.methodology: Projecting emotion word embeddings onto a Valence-Arousal plane to assess psychological differences (e.g., Pride vs. Shame in US vs. Japan), analyzing token probabilities for context-emotion pairs across cultures, and conducting human evaluations of model responses to culturally sensitive scenarios prompted in different languages.

Calculating distance-based similarities of emotion embeddings between monolingual and multilingual RoBERTa models to measure whether non-English emotion representations are inappropriately anchored to English semantic structures.
